name: safari-media.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  safari-media.scss — Safari-only <media-figure> overrides injected into the
//  shadow root by safari-patch.js: old-Safari border-radius + mask-image clip
//  workaround and autoplay video sizing.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@import '../../base/variables';
@import '../../base/mixins';

:host {
  width: auto;
  height: 100%;
  display: inline-block;
}

figure {
  position: relative;
  height: 100%;
  width: auto;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  overflow: hidden;
  // Old Safari fails to clip replaced content (img/video) to border-radius —
  // the mask-image gradient forces the compositor to clip at the corners.
  -webkit-border-radius: to-rem($space-md);
  border-radius: to-rem($space-md);
  -webkit-mask-image: -webkit-radial-gradient(var(--color-white-raw), var(--black));
  mask-image: -webkit-radial-gradient(var(--color-white-raw), var(--black));
  background-color: var(--bg-dark);
  cursor: pointer;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;

  @include layout-1024() {
    -webkit-border-radius: to-rem($space-lg);
    border-radius: to-rem($space-lg);
  }
}

// Intrinsic natural size from the width/height attrs; the mf vars act as
// caps only, so Safari carousel slides keep mixed widths and never upscale
// past the source resolution — the same contract as media-figure.scss.
.render-placeholder {
  width: auto;
  height: auto;
  max-width: var(--mf-w, var(--mf-max-w, none));
  max-height: var(--mf-h, calc(70dvh - #{to-rem($space-xl * 2)}));
  object-fit: contain;
}

// Carousel strip contract (same as media-figure.scss): slides share the
// --mf-h strip height so media always fills the row; width stays
// aspect-driven with a 320px floor on ≥375px viewports so tall media
// never collapse to slivers. The placeholder is transparent — the media
// layers cover-crop the box, so the floor never distorts the image.
:host(.internal-extra-item) .render-placeholder,
:host([classes*='internal-extra-item']) .render-placeholder {
  height: var(--mf-h, calc(70dvh - #{to-rem($space-xl * 2)}));
  width: auto;
  max-width: var(--mf-max-w, calc(100vw - #{to-rem($space-3xl * 2)} - #{to-rem(48)}));
  max-height: none;

  @include layout-375() {
    min-width: to-rem(320);
  }
}

.render-media,
video.render-media {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  -webkit-border-radius: inherit;
  border-radius: inherit;
}

.render-media {
  // Layer 1: the tiny preview — always visible underneath at 70% opacity.
  &--thumb {
    filter: none;
    transform: none;
    z-index: 1;
    opacity: 0.7;
    transition: opacity 0.25s ease;
  }

  // Layer 2: the full-res media — starts transparent above the thumb, fades
  // in once loaded (the crossfade replaces the blur-up technique Safari
  // can't composite smoothly).
  &--high {
    opacity: 0;
    z-index: 2;
    transition: opacity 0.25s ease;

    &[src]:not([src='']) {
      opacity: 1;
    }

    &.render-media--loaded {
      opacity: 1;
    }
  }
}

figure:has(.render-media--loaded) .render-media--thumb,
figure:has(.render-media--high.render-media--loaded) .render-media--thumb {
  display: none;
}

.exp-md-open-1 {
  cursor: pointer;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  pointer-events: auto;
  z-index: 10;
}

figure.internal-expand video.render-media {
  pointer-events: none;
}

// Keyboard focus ring on this shadow root's tabbable elements — the file
// doesn't import _structure (which emits it globally), so include the
// shared scope explicitly.
@include focus-ring-scope;
